http_boundaries.scope: Real HTTP and exact shipping SDK methods with synthetic WASM exports; does not qualify Rust rendering, owner attachment, or gateway status

limits: Browser statuses and attempt records are read from actual Playwright JSON, not inferred from the workflow conclusion. All selected Playwright cases have one passed result at retry0; their recorded project config retries are preserved.

Only these three original artifacts are downloaded for this browser lane. The summary manifest references1745 files, of which12 are included and hash-verified here;1733 referenced files, including many browser captures/probe binaries, are not independently downloaded by this review.
Pixel JSON is an original checker report; this projection does not independently rerun OCR/pixel comparison or visually certify every omitted screenshot.

HTTP controls explicitly use exact shipping SDK methods with synthetic WASM exports; they do not qualify Rust rendering, owner attachment, or gateway status. Pixel checks and SDK probe counts are not additional independent Playwright test cases.
CJK/IME/widget probes retain appQualified=false and their precise CPU/text/borrow-only scope; no GPU, physical IME, independent Root/issuer/owner, or B16 normal-entry acceptance is inferred.
The gateway commands retain their original filtering and console skips; no undocumented retry override is inferred from an all-PASS result.
Source/merge executions are separate. Browser merge and native-presentation merge are different commit objects despite the same product tree.
